titulo: Three, two, one, instead of when I'm ready
caption:
Three, two, one, instead of when I'm ready

"When I'm ready." "Three, two, one." The clock said go, and the first box got ticked before the readiness showed up.

Ready rarely arrives on its own, and a countdown gets you moving without waiting for it.

For whoever counts down from three instead of waiting to feel ready.

Choose friction.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A room with a long table, a big computer screen on the right with the title task and three lines, and a clock above it that shows a question mark. A royal blue block figure with narrowed eyes says when I'm ready. A ink-black block figure with white eyes answers three, two, one, and the clock counts 3, 2, 1 and then shows go, and two boxes on the screen get ticked. The blue one's eyes go wide and says ...ok. starting. Both end with happy eyes. The text stays: me: three, two, one, go.
